source: Manatee County Volunteer Fire Department - Station 12

entries.notes: Roof partially collapsed on east wing. Structural walls cracked. Active gas leak reported, utilities shut off. Uninhabitable. Elderly resident evacuated by unit.

Significant window damage on south-facing facade, interior water intrusion reported in two rooms. Roof shingles missing but decking appears intact. INTENTIONAL_DISCREPANCY: actual damage is severe — rear load-bearing wall has visible bow and foundation cracking not noted by field crew.
Commercial strip facade sign blown down, parking lot debris. Building envelope appears sound. No structural concerns observed.
Single-family residence reduced to slab. Entire roof and upper structure absent. Debris field extends ~40 ft into adjacent lot. No occupants located.
Garage door blown in, vehicle inside crushed by falling soffit. Interior living space appears dry. Fencing destroyed on all sides.
Newer construction, impact windows intact. No visible damage observed from street. Resident confirmed minimal interior issues.
Several roof tiles displaced. Screened lanai enclosure torn. No apparent structural compromise. Owner on site, declined further inspection.

source: Manatee County Building Inspection - Rapid Damage Assessment Team B

entries.notes: Total loss confirmed. Slab-on-grade only remaining. Red-tagged. Owner notified via emergency contact list. Debris poses hazard to neighboring parcels.
Collapsed roof section confirmed on east side. Multiple interior load-bearing walls compromised. Red-tagged, do not occupy. Gas company notified separately.

INTENTIONAL_DISCREPANCY: Field inspector noted missing shingles and broken windows and coded moderate. Subsequent review indicates truss damage visible from attic access and major soffit collapse — actual severity is severe. Yellow-tagged pending re-inspection.
Storm surge inundation to approx. 4 ft inside structure. Drywall, flooring, HVAC, and electrical panels all submerged. Mold growth already initiating. Red-tagged.

INTENTIONAL_DISCREPANCY: Address does not exist in county parcel records. Field team likely transposed digits — no structure located at this address during GPS verification. Entry flagged for correction.
Fence line down, one window cracked. Roof appears intact from ground inspection. Yellow-tag not warranted; owner advised to monitor.
Confirmed garage structural damage. Interior dry wall check showed no moisture beyond garage bay. Coded moderate, yellow-tagged. Recommend follow-up on roof edge flashing.
Agricultural outbuilding roof panels peeled back. Residence on same parcel undamaged. Owner present and conducting own cleanup.

source: American Red Cross - Manatee/Hillsborough Disaster Response Team 4

entries.notes: Family of four sheltering in place, second bedroom unusable due to water intrusion. Provided emergency supplies and cots. Roof damage visible but family declined shelter referral. INTENTIONAL_DISCREPANCY: Red Cross volunteer did not access rear of structure where fire dept and building inspector would later confirm severe load-bearing wall damage.
Elderly couple rescued by neighbor. Significant water damage throughout ground floor. Occupants transferred to Palmetto Community Center shelter. Pet accommodations arranged.
Complete structural loss. No occupants on site. Neighbor reports family evacuated prior to storm. Red Cross case opened for displaced family; contact info obtained from neighbor.

Two-story home, entire second floor roof gone. First floor accessible but saturated. Single mother with three children relocated to shelter. Large tree through living room ceiling. NOTE: This property was NOT included in fire dept or building inspector reports — INTENTIONAL_DISCREPANCY: unreported by other teams.
Resident flagged Red Cross vehicle. Minimal shingle loss and one cracked window pane. Occupants safe, no assistance needed beyond informational pamphlets.
Drive-by assessment only. No visible damage, no residents flagged for assistance.

Waterfront condominium building, ground floor units fully inundated by surge. Approx. 11 displaced residents. Multiple cases opened. Building management on site. NOTE: This property also NOT appearing in fire dept or building inspector reports — INTENTIONAL_DISCREPANCY: second unreported severely damaged property.
